headline: Universal Legal acts for DSP Designs on its sale to Anarock Group
sum: Anarock Group has acquired a majority stake in DSP Design Associates. Universal Legal advised the promoters of DSP Designs, Bimal Desai, Mehul Shah and Yatin Patel, on the sale of their stakes to Anarock.
detail: Anarock Group has acquired a majority stake in DSP Design Associates. Universal Legal advised the promoters of DSP Designs, Bimal Desai, Mehul Shah and Yatin Patel, on the sale of their stakes to Anarock. The firm provided end-to-end legal support on the transaction, including structuring, drafting and negotiation of legal documents, and closing assistance. The transaction team consisted of Mohit Kapoor (Senior Partner), Neha Sehgal (Partner) and Preksha Shah (Associate).
